player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Slitherlink on a {R}x{C} grid!
Draw a single continuous loop so each numbered cell has that many bordering edges.
Toggle edges with:
  [h r c] - toggle horizontal edge above dots at row r, column c
  [v r c] - toggle vertical edge left of dots at row r, column c
Numbers show required edge count, '.' means no constraint.
You have up to {max_turns} moves to solve the puzzle.
